name: amplemarket
description: Connect Amplemarket to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use Amplemarket MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect Amplemarket to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with sales prospecting and enrichment using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my Amplemarket workspace.
Find anything in Amplemarket that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review sales prospecting and enrichment in Amplemarket.
